Name: Bounce Band
Description: Bounces off all thrown items

Name: Covert Cloak
Description: You do not suffer additional effects of Physical and Special Moves.

Name: Curve Band
Description: Makes items thrown in a straight-line ricochet off walls.

Name: Def. Scarf
Description: Boosts user's Defence Modifier by 2.

Name: Detect Band
Description: You roll 1 additional Skill Die when making an Awareness Check.

Name: Friend Bow
Description: You gain 2 Friendship Dice whenever you clear your Friendship Track. You roll 1 additional Skill Die when recruiting a Pokémon to your Team.

Name: Focus Band
Description: If the User would be reduced to 0HP, roll a d6. On a 3-6, you drop to 1HP instead. You can only use this Item once per battle.

Name: Gold Bow
Description: High priced item.

Name: Choice Band
Description: Your first Physical Move in a Battle has its Move Power increased by 1, but you cannot use any other Move for the rest of the Battle.

Name: Choice Scarf
Description: The first Move you use in a Battle becomes a Priority Move, but you cannot use any other Move for the rest of the Battle.

Name: Heal Ribbon
Description: When you use a Move that heals, you roll an additional dice.

Name: Mobile Scarf
Description: Boosts user's Speed Modifier by 2, and allows the user to walk on any surface.

Description: Boosts user's Attack and Special Attack modifier by 5, but you need to eat twice as much per day.

Description: Prevents Items from being Sticky.

Name: Pass Scarf

Name: Pecha Scarf
Description: Prevents Poisoned and Badly Poisoned conditions.

Name: Persim Band
Description: Prevents Confused condition.

Name: Pierce Band
Description: Makes items thrown in a straight-line Pierce through everything without stopping until it hits a Wall.

Name: Power Band
Description: Boosts user's Attack modifier by 2.

Name: Racket Band
Description: Prevents Asleep condition.

Name: Sneak Scarf
Description: You roll 1 additional Skill Die when making a Sneak Check.

Name: Special Ribbon
Description: Boosts user's Special Attack modifier by 2.

Name: Stamina Band
Description: You roll 1 additional Skill Die when making an Endurance Check.

Name: Tracker Band
Description: Your Team always knows your location.

Name: Trap Scarf
Description: Prevents traps from going off if stepped on.

Name: Twist Band
Description: Prevents Attack and Special Attack from lowering.

Name: Warp Scarf

Description: The user ignores weather effects

Name: Zinc Band
